phase_boundary: This task authors source only; no builder, oracle, harness or candidate import/execution.

A new metadata-only admission must run the reviewed builder without oracle/candidate, retain materialization receipt and exact manifest bytes/counts/workload/hash, and independently audit exhaustive coefficient-code/assignment enumeration plus every registered control and malformed mutation value/type before native freeze.

Only after independent static review, native schema validation/freeze, publication and exact separate execution approval may runtime load frozen manifest, compute oracle, import candidate once, make fixed calls and finalize under external deadline. Runtime never regenerates cases.
order: family/case; ascending then descending insertion; list then tuple; repeat 0 then 1; reference, sweep, restrictions in ascending depth. Malformed mutation then repeat then API.
resource_status: Proposals only. The additional supervisor envelope must be explicitly budgeted and approved; it is not added to worker time. Native verifier itself executes inside parent startup bound and external parent resource envelope.
resource_preconditions: Existing unprivileged dedicated owned cgroup v2 domain, no children; cpu.max quota equals period, memory.max=536870912, memory.swap.max=0, memory.oom.group=1, pids.max=1.

Parent remains outside worker cgroup; child blocks on pipe before source imports. Parent moves child to existing cgroup, checks singleton membership and every controller, confirms external prearmed absolute deadline, then releases.

Worker imports/finalization inside 60-second deadline. External prearmed deadline may end earlier; no retry or extra worker grace. Parent bounded five-second cleanup only. Parent cannot promote success if custody/termination/readback uncertain.
unresolved_bindings: Independent static source review and any corrections.

Separately admitted materialized manifest SHA/byte count, exact oracle workload and generation receipt, plus independent prefreeze metadata audit of exhaustive enumeration, every registered control and every malformed mutation/type.
Explicit exact public extraction/restriction return layouts; current public API omits containers.
Native specification and experiment.protocol/v1 IDs, real schema validation/freeze, native run and claim records, approval, separate invocation allowance.

Native admission-verifier executable, authoritative record validation/atomic single-use ownership semantics, pinned hash, exact command and external supervisor integration.
Existing authorized cgroup delegation and kernel controller availability; external parent budget enforcement; prearmed external worker deadline.
Approved supervisor startup/cleanup resource/cost envelope and artifact journal/storage allowance; publication and readback receipt.
Concrete fresh output directory, launch command, frozen protocol digest; runtime output rows/terminal/export mapping and durable hashes.
runtime_binding_schema: prime-scalar.native-runtime-binding/v1; distinct from this deliberately non-executable draft

native_verifier_output_contract.meaning: These are verified responses from the independently pinned native authority adapter, not self-issued assertions. Exact implementation and hostile/failure review are future prerequisites.

acceptance: Exact finite-case semantics only after all 23952 calls and 649 cases, controls, repeats, invariants, immutability, source/artifact digests and enforcement checks complete. First mismatch fails. Missing/timeout/OOM/termination uncertainty is incomplete. No timing comparison.
campaign: Producer slots consumed 2/2 unchanged; independent reserved software slot untouched. No new execution allowance from these files.
downstream: Finite standalone software semantics; all 106 coordinate + 6 coefficient comparisons, five leads, complete charts/projected models, witnesses, independent all-generator reconstruction and certificate checks/costs remain unchanged.
manifest_validation_scope: Runtime verifies digest, canonical representations, family/count totals, schedule, valid case-to-realization binding and malformed typed-tree round trips/arity. It does not independently prove that case values exhaust every coefficient code or that each malformed value/control exactly matches the spec; the reviewed frozen manifest and mandatory independent prefreeze metadata audit supply that binding. No runtime case regeneration.
